Class Isotopes

java.lang.Object
org.openscience.cdk.config.Isotopes
All Implemented Interfaces:
IsotopeFactory
public final class Isotopes extends Object implements IsotopeFactory
Static utility functions for working with isotopes with efficient retrieving the major isotope of an element (major(int)) as well as it's average/natural mass (average(int)). You can also fetch a specific isotope with get(int, int).

For backwards compatibility you can obtain an instance of the class which implements the IsotopeFactory API.

Data is taken from the Blue Obelisk Data Repository, version 10 [Willighagen, E. and Hutchinson, G. and Niehaus, C. and Buchwald, J. and Pfeiffer, M. and Leidert, D. and Brefort, J., Blue Obelisk Data Repository (version 10)]. The data set is described in the first Blue Obelisk paper [Guha, R. et. al.. J. Chem. Inf. Model.. 2006. 46].

The isotopes.dat file that is optionally used by this class is a binary class of this data, improving loading times over the BODR XML representation. It is only used for the uncommon isotopes and is not loaded unless required. It is created from the original BODR files using tools from the GenerateIsotopeData in 'cdk-extra' tests.

Author:
Egon Willighagen, John Mayfield

  • Method Details

    • average

      public static double average(int elem)
      Obtain the average/natural atomic mass for a given element based on its natural abundance. 
      Isotopes.average(IElement.C); // 12.01074
Isotopes.average(IElement.N); // 14.0067
Isotopes.average(IElement.Tc); // 0.0 (no natural isotopes)
      Parameters:
      elem - the atomic number of element
      Returns:
      the average/natural mass, 0 if no natural isotopes

    • major

      public static IIsotope major(int elem)
      Obtain the major isotope for a given element based on its natural abundance. 
      Isotopes.major(IElement.C); // 12-C
Isotopes.major(IElement.N); // 14-C
Isotopes.major(IElement.Tc); // null (no major isotopes)
      Parameters:
      elem - the atomic number of element
      Returns:
      the major isotope, or null if there isn't one

    • get

      public static List<IIsotope> get(int elem)
      Obtain a list of all known isotopes for an element. This requires loading a resource file. 
      Isotopes.major(IElement.C);  // [12-C, 13-C, 8-C, 9-C, ...]
Isotopes.major(IElement.Mc); // [287-Mc, 288-Mc, ...]
      Parameters:
      elem - the atomic number
      Returns:
      the known isotopes, the order is not guaranteed

    • get

      public static IIsotope get(int elem, int mass)
      Get an isotope of an element loaded with the exact mass and natural abundance (if any). 
      Isotopes.get(IElement.H, 2); // deuterium
Isotopes.get(IElement.C, 12);  // carbon-12
Isotopes.get(IElement.C, 13); // carbon-13
Isotopes.get(IElement.C, 99); // null - carbon-99 doesn't exist!
      Parameters:
      elem - the atomic number
      mass - the mass number
      Returns:
      the isotope, null if not found

    • getMajorIsotope

      public IIsotope getMajorIsotope(int atomicNum)
      Returns the most abundant (major) isotope with a given atomic number. Note that some high mass elements do not have a major isotopes (0% abundance) and this method will return null for those.
      Specified by:
      getMajorIsotope in interface IsotopeFactory
      Parameters:
      atomicNum - The atomicNumber for which an isotope is to be returned
      Returns:
      The isotope corresponding to the given atomic number
